rules.baseline: Actual unchanged engine and simulator, same previous study parameters. Spot explicit 400-day input warmup sensitivity (not production 220-day transport parity).
rules.ladder-equal: Spot only. Existing configurable ladder percentages 25/25/25/25. Scenario allocation remains 10/20/35/35. No engine/level/exit change.
rules.ladder-front: Spot only. Existing configurable ladder percentages 40/30/20/10. Same total capital/scenario allocation and levels; more initial exposure, not free profit.
rules.weekday-only: Reject new engine admissions on Saturday/Sunday UTC. Never force a trade or close/reallocate an existing holding. Not a full time-strategy or Gunbot parity.
rules.trail-2atr: Futures research-only stepPosition wrapper. Existing SL/ONE TP/liquidation evaluated first. On CLOSED 4h bars only, arm at >=1 original R close-to-entry. Track best CLOSED price, ratchet SL to bestClose minus/plus 2*Wilder ATR14 of closed 4h bars. Effective for the next bar only. Never loosen initial SL, never move TP. Missing/stale ATR prevents ratchet. This changes simulated exits, NOT production PP and NOT proven live execution.
rules.timeout-6bars: Futures research-only wrapper. At first observed 4h OPEN after six signal-timeframe durations from entry, process original gap SL/TP/liquidation first, then close remaining position at that OPEN with adverse configured stop slippage and fee. No future OHLC available. 15m/1h timeout resolution is rounded UP to 4h quote, not exact native timer.

protocol.costStress: Every arm at 2x fee and impact/slippage; rerun engine, not recost fixed trades.
protocol.data: Existing hash-verified public Binance H2 2025 archive. Spot warmup extended with overlapping H1 cache after byte-equivalent row check. No network, credentials, database or account actions. All evidence strictly native close<decision. Previously observed data, NOT an unseen holdout.
protocol.sample: 64 fresh replay runs: 16 Spot portfolio runs plus 48 Futures per-symbol runs. Three large-cap symbols selected before prior studies, no universe generalization. No parameter optimization.
protocol.screen: Positive MTM and positive paired delta in BOTH quarters under normal AND doubled costs, no worse portfolio MTM drawdown per quarter, >=30 closed cycles/trades across quarters and positive closed net. Even passing is exploratory only, never profitability proof.
protocol.notTested: Exact proprietary StepGrid/Grid/DCA/TrailMe, Spot trailing lifecycle, Futures DCA/grid, standalone indicator strategies or full live AI/scanner/execution. Existing fixed Spot daily OHLC buy-before-sell ambiguity remains; report it. No claims for MEXC/Gate.
